Players Committee card image of [[Dash Rendar (V)]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. May move as a 'react'. When in battle with Leebo (or opponent's gangster, [Permanent Weapon] card, or [Maintenance] card), may draw one destiny; subtract that amount from opponent's total power and attrition.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e0ebcbc/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/large/dashrendar.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/large/dashrendar.gif] as of commit e0ebcbc “Set 10 images” (7 January 2019).
